mapper.insert: insert into MST_DEALER_INFO (CUSTOMER_ID, DEALER_NO, TRADE_MARKET, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dealerNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeMarket,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})

insert into MST_DEALER_DETAIL_INFO (SEQ_NO, CUSTOMER_ID, DEALER_NO, DEALER_PARTY_NO, DEALER_PARTY_TYPE, DEALER_PARTY_NAME, TRADER_NO, TRADER_NAME, IS_OUR, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dealerNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dealerPartyNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dealerPartyType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dealerPartyName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{traderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trader,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isOur,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: update MST_DEALER_INFO set DEALER_NO = #{dealerNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DEALER_NO = #{dealNoPre,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select:
select CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
IS_BROKER is not null
and (CUSTOMER_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or CUSTOMER_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
and CUSTOMER_ID = #{initValue}
select CUSTOMER_ID from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci where CUSTOMER_NAME = #{dealerName}
select count(*) from MST_DEALER_DETAIL_INFO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId}
select count (*) from MST_DEALER_INFO where CUSTOMER_ID=#{dealerName} and DEALER_NO = #{dealerNo}
select count (*) from MST_DEALER_INFO where CUSTOMER_ID=#{dealerName} and TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket}

select MDDI.SEQ_NO seqNo, MDDI.DEALER_PARTY_NO, MDDI.DEALER_PARTY_TYPE, MDDI.DEALER_PARTY_NAME, MDDI.TRADER_NO , MDDI.TRADER_NAME trader, MDDI.IS_OUR from MST_DEALER_INFO mdi inner JOIN MST_DEALER_DETAIL_INFO MDDI on mdi.DEALER_NO = MDDI.DEALER_NO and MDDI.CUSTOMER_ID=mdi.CUSTOMER_ID where mdi.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} and mdi.DEALER_NO = #{dealerNo}

select count(1) from MST_DEALER_INFO mdi inner join MST_DEALER_DETAIL_INFO MDDI on mdi.DEALER_NO = MDDI.DEALER_NO AND MDI.CUSTOMER_ID = MDDI.CUSTOMER_ID where mdi.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} AND MDI.DEALER_NO = #{dealerNo} and mddi.IS_OUR = 'Y'

select count(1) from (select DEALER_PARTY_NO from MST_DEALER_DETAIL_INFO mddi inner JOIN MST_DEALER_INFO mdi on mdi.DEALER_NO = MDDI.DEALER_NO and MDDI.CUSTOMER_ID = mdi.CUSTOMER_ID where mdi.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} AND MDI.DEALER_NO = #{dealerNo} and mdi.TRADE_MARKET = '04' and mddi.DEALER_PARTY_TYPE in('03','04')) aa
mapper.delete: delete from MST_DEALER_DETAIL_INFO where CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} and DEALER_NO = #{dealerNo}
